hooks.name: Auto commit and push on file save
hooks.description: After any file is saved in the workspace, stages all changes, commits with a timestamp, and pushes to GitHub LedgerLine- repo

action.command: cd C:\Users\Hp\Documents\snovyasis && git add . && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore: auto-save update [$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')]" && git push origin master
